youtube.description:
Kiro file hook not firing when you save? The real reason

Your Kiro file hook isn't firing when you save? Here's why.

1. The myth - Save a file and the hook runs.
2. The fact - File hooks respond to agent changes only.
3. What that means - Your own editor saves don't trigger them.
4. The fix - Let the agent make the change, or use another trigger.

Docs: https://kiro.dev/docs/hooks/types/
